name: Yellow Skunk 98
author: Artahs
description: Dark red button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #730603 to #a50000.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Yellow Skunk 98</title>
<style>
/* Yellow Skunk 98 by Artahs — https://uiverse.io/Artahs/yellow-skunk-98 */
.button {
  cursor: pointer;
  border: solid;
  border-color: #5b5958;
  border-radius: 7px;
  width: 200px;
  height: 50px;
  background-color: #730603;
  color: #ffc900;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-shadow: black 2px 1px;
  -web-kit-box-shadow: inset 0px 0px 1.5px 2px #000000, 0px 0px 15px 3px #000000;
  box-shadow: inset 0px 0px 1.5px 2px #000000, 0px 0px 15px 3px #000000;
}
.button:hover {
  background-color: #a50000;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Enter the game</button>

</body>
</html>
